summary: Phase 3 test strategy is complete for the teacher content-authoring composer UI and preview phase. It defines targeted Red/Green commands, required failing tests for composer logic, schema-driven forms, live preview through the existing lesson/activity renderer path, status surfacing from Phase 2 DTOs, human-gated UMV handling, accessibility/responsive expectations, UX browser-review route guidance, artifact-vs-live behavior boundaries, and A1-A12 anti-pattern coverage.
nonblocking_findings: Existing dev review harness previews are largely placeholder summaries, so Phase 3 tests must prove authored content reaches LessonRenderer/PhaseRenderer/ActivityRenderer or a harness wrapper delegating to those components rather than relying on harness placeholder DOM.

ActivityRenderer currently exposes componentKey/activityId/mode/callbacks but not authored props in its public props type; Phase 3 implementation must safely extend or adapt the preview data path and cover it with live render tests.
UX-browser-review applies because this is a user-facing UI phase; the recommended dev URL is /teacher/content-authoring?preview=1 once the IM3 dev server is running.
evidence: Read measure/index.md, workflow.md, tracks.md, anti-patterns.md, track spec.md, track plan.md, prior Phase 2 test-strategy.md, and phase-2-acceptance-result.json.
